searchText: The EIP (and the EL) only deals with amounts in WEI Hey guys, I'm interested is there any possibility to play with withdrawals using json-rpc at the moment? Wow, does that mean if all 500k validators decide to withdraw at the same time, it only takes them 4.5 days to get the withdrawal? Isn't there a limit of 7 withdrawals per epoch or sth at the moment? yes, exit != withdrawal. For all validators to exit it would take months So there's partial withdrawals that are 'business as usual' where you get back any balance in excess of the 32 eth, and if all 500k have creds, then that is the timeline that i'm referring to... As <@397389662085185547> indicated, exiting is a whole other thing with its own limits and constraints... Full withdrawals do happen during the same sweep, so if there's a number of full withdrawals due, they'll all be processed when it's their turn.
